subject.title: Feature: Auto-leave WhatsApp groups not in allowlist + group-join webhook

question: Should OpenClaw add an opt-in WhatsApp auto-leave policy keyed to unauthorized group JIDs now, while routing join notifications and any generic manual-leave API through the broader group-admission design?
rationale: The dependency supports the mechanics, but maintainers must choose the destructive-action boundary, the permanent config/tool surface, and whether privacy-sensitive join events are channel-local or cross-channel.

options.title: Narrow WhatsApp policy
options.body: Add an opt-in WhatsApp unknown-group warn/leave policy based on channels.whatsapp.groups, while coordinating generic join notifications with the broader group-admission issue.

options.title: Unified admission design
options.body: Defer implementation until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/11489 defines one cross-channel pairing, notification, rejection, and leave contract.

options.title: Keep deny-only behavior
options.body: Retain message suppression and diagnostics only, requiring operators to leave unauthorized groups manually in WhatsApp.

recommendation.title: Narrow WhatsApp policy
recommendation.body: Add an opt-in WhatsApp unknown-group warn/leave policy based on channels.whatsapp.groups, while coordinating generic join notifications with the broader group-admission issue.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice sets a security-sensitive product contract across channel configuration, destructive actions, and potentially shared group-admission APIs.
